operations.why: Protocol 2168 writes the ResourcePackClientResponse discriminator as an unsigned varuint32 before the lowercase response name. Endstone incorrectly declares the selector as int8; values 0 through 3 hide the width error because their canonical one-byte encodings coincide.

evidence.summary: The pinned protocol-2168 serializer stores Response as uint32 and marshals it with Varuint32 before the response name and optional pack list.
